note_en: 之所以 A，是因为 B means "the reason A is that B": you first state a known fact, then give its cause. In the text: 之所以退得这么多，是因为镜头里的颜色和衣服本来的颜色不一样 "the reason so many were returned was that the colors on camera didn't match the clothes' real colors." 之所以 can also follow the subject: 这么多人之所以买你的橘子，是因为便宜吗？ "are so many people buying your mandarins because they're cheap?" Don't confuse it with 因为…所以…, where the cause comes first; here the result comes first and the explanation follows 是因为.
